nodes.label: Bevel Motif (raised surface / concave well)
nodes.rationale: Bevel = raised surfaces (button, chip) get inset top-edge highlight + hard-edge colored drop bevel that collapses on press; concave wells (interior panels, inventory slots) invert this with dark inner shadow — creates game-HUD tactility without blur.

nodes.label: Typography Scale (Space Grotesk / Manrope / JetBrains Mono)
nodes.rationale: Original Minecraft pixel font substituted with readable webfonts for legibility while keeping game-UI character.
nodes.norm_label: typography scale (space grotesk / manrope / jetbrains mono)

nodes.label: Spacing / Radius / Bento Grid System
nodes.rationale: 8px base grid; bento variation lives in cell span rather than gap so sections don't look like a uniform grid.
